_meta.note: Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader. Used to track data provenance.
_meta.source: Itinerary supplied by the traveller. Only their stops are included — no invented stops.
_meta.routeSource: OSRM public demo (router.project-osrm.org), driving profile, via `npm run routes`
_meta.routeSimplification: Thinned to a minimum spacing of 0.6 km between adjacent coordinates
_meta.coordinateSource: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) lookups for Skjeggedal, Vøringsfossen, Trolltunga, Flåm, Stegastein, Myrdal, Tyinkrysset, Bergen and Oslo Gardermoen
warnings: The Trolltunga hike and the Flåm Railway are hand-drawn approximations. Routing APIs do not cover trails or rail, so those lines differ from the real trail and track.
Descriptions are rough placeholders, to be rewritten by the traveller.
Dates are set in 2026. Adjust startDate and every day date if the year is different.

days.title: Arrive Oslo → drive to Trolltunga
days.summary: Land at Gardermoen at 11:30, pick up the car and drive across to the Trolltunga trailhead, arriving after midnight.

notes.text: This is a very long first day: roughly 8 hours of driving straight off a flight, finishing in the dark.

places.name: Oslo Gardermoen Airport
places.imageCredit: Avinor Oslo lufthavn/Espen Solli · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Trolltunga Trailhead Stay
places.description: Base for the Trolltunga hike. Booked on Airbnb.

notes.text: Arrival is 00:00 on 18 Aug — the night of the 17th.
Nature exactly as it is. The bathroom is awkward, but you get used to it and then it's fine. This one was my personal favourite of the three.

days.title: Trolltunga hike
days.summary: Out and back to Trolltunga. The whole day.

places.name: Trolltunga
places.description: A slab of rock jutting out high above Lake Ringedalsvatnet.

days.title: Vøringsfossen → Bergen
days.summary: Leave Trolltunga, stop at Vøringsfossen, continue to Bergen.

places.name: Vøringsfossen
places.description: Waterfall dropping into the Måbødalen gorge, with a stepped bridge across it.
places.imageCredit: Netha Hussain · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Bergen Stay
places.description: Two nights in Bergen. Booked on Airbnb.

notes.text: Easy to get into Bergen from here. Genuinely comfortable, like a real home, and the kitchen is well equipped.

days.title: Bergen
days.summary: A day in Bergen — into the city centre, the fish market and Bryggen.

places.name: Bergen Fish Market
places.description: The harbourfront fish market in the middle of Bergen.

notes.text: Not worth eating at. Skip the meal here.
The supermarkets are cheaper and better.

places.name: Bryggen
places.description: The old Hanseatic wharf, a row of wooden trading houses on the harbour.
places.imageCredit: Diego Delso · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

days.title: Bergen → Flåm → Stegastein → Tyinkrysset
days.summary: Drive east through Flåm, up to the Stegastein viewpoint, then on to Tyinkrysset for two nights.

places.name: Flåm
places.description: Passing through on the way east.
places.imageCredit: Kenny Louie · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Stegastein Viewpoint
places.description: Timber viewing deck reaching out high above the Aurlandsfjord.

notes.text: The road up is narrow and steep with tight hairpins.

places.name: Tyinkrysset Stay
places.description: Two nights at Tyinkrysset. Booked on Airbnb.

notes.text: An hour out from Flåm, but well worth it. The lake view is superb.

days.title: Flåm Railway
days.summary: Drive over to Flåm for the mountain railway, then back to Tyinkrysset for the last night.

legs.note: Flåm Railway to Myrdal and back.

places.name: Flåm Railway
places.description: Mountain railway climbing from Flåm up to Myrdal.

notes.text: If you already have a car, the railway is not worth what it costs. We would not recommend it.
After the railway we returned to the same accommodation at Tyinkrysset for the second night.

days.title: Tyinkrysset → Oslo, fly home
days.summary: Leave Tyinkrysset and drive back to Gardermoen for the 18:30 departure.

notes.text: Work backwards from the 18:30 flight and leave enough slack for the drive and the car return.

places.name: Oslo Gardermoen Airport
places.description: Return the rental car and fly home.
